name: Mine accidents, injuries and illnesses by state, county and degree of injury (MSHA), 2000 to 2026
description: Accident, injury and illness reports that U.S. mine operators and contractors file with the Mine Safety and Health Administration, counted for the nation and for each state and calendar year from 2000 to October 2026, and for each county over the last ten full years (2016 to 2025), by degree of injury: deaths, permanent disabilities, lost-time injuries, restricted-activity injuries, injuries with no lost time and all other reports. State and national records also split reports and deaths between coal and metal/nonmetal mines. Counts only: no narratives, names of operators, occupations or ages are kept.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Mine accidents, injuries and illnesses by state, county and degree of injury (MSHA), 2000 to 2026 (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116045

distribution.name: mine-accidents.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: mine-accidents.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: mine-accidents-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in mine-accidents-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to mine-accidents.csv on id.

recordSet.name: mine-accidents
recordSet.description: The records of Mine accidents, injuries and illnesses by state, county and degree of injury (MSHA), 2000 to 2026, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or US

field.name: level
field.description: us, state, county or county-not-recorded

field.name: status
field.description: P: MSHA's own record

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Reports (the same as reports)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: reports
field.description: Accident, injury and illness reports filed with MSHA

field.name: fatalities
field.description: Reports with degree of injury fatality

field.name: permanent_disability
field.description: Permanent total or partial disability

field.name: lost_time
field.description: Days away from work, with or without restricted activity

field.name: restricted_only
field.description: Days of restricted activity only

field.name: no_lost_time
field.description: No days away and no restricted activity

field.name: other
field.description: All other reports: accident only, occupational illness, natural causes, nonemployees, first aid

field.name: dataThrough
field.description: Date of the last accident in the file

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
